# Genit AI

> Genit is an end-to-end AI marketing platform where autonomous agents plan, create, automate, publish, communicate, and optimize across connected business tools.

Genit is not only an AI media designer. Image, video, copy, document, presentation, and brand asset generation are creative capabilities inside a broader marketing execution platform.

## Core capabilities

- [AI Marketing Agents](https://www.trygenit.com/platform/ai-marketing-agents): Brand-aware agents that plan multi-step work and take approved actions.
- [Marketing Automation](https://www.trygenit.com/platform/marketing-automation): Visual and conversational workflows with triggers, logic, schedules, webhooks, AI steps, and connected apps.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.trygenit.com/platform/social-media-management): Create, adapt, schedule, publish, and monitor social content.
- [Content Creation](https://www.trygenit.com/platform/content-creation): Generate copy, images, video, voice-assisted prompts, documents, reports, spreadsheets, and presentations.
- [Campaign Management](https://www.trygenit.com/platform/campaign-management): Plan audiences, funnels, calendars, KPIs, outbound work, attribution, and optimization.
- [Unified Inbox](https://www.trygenit.com/platform/unified-inbox): Manage supported social, messaging, and email conversations in one workspace.
- [Brand Intelligence](https://www.trygenit.com/platform/brand-intelligence): Turn a website and user guidance into reusable brand, product, audience, voice, and visual context.
- [Marketing Integrations](https://www.trygenit.com/platform/marketing-integrations): Connect agents and workflows to social, email, ads, Google Workspace, commerce, CRM, and more than 1,000 business apps.

## Product boundaries

Actions available through an integration depend on the connected provider, account permissions, API availability, and user approval settings. Genit keeps users in control of consequential external actions.
